source: NOAA MADIS ACARS, public archive: the eddy dissipation rate (EDR) many US airliners report automatically at cruise
definition: Flights counted for a route: its own trips, plus other flights that cruised along at least half of its great circle within 50 nm. Smooth: no reading above EDR 0.10 at cruise (ICAO's 'nil' for a medium jet). Calm: none at 0.20 or above (below ICAO's 'moderate').
